description: A sprite sheet of TWELVE separate game item icons arranged in a grid of 4 columns and 3 rows, each centered in its own cell. Rows 1 and 2: eight small paper seed packets tied with string, each with a picture of its plant on the front: prickly pear cactus, white snow strawberry, pale blue snow radish, red fire melon, golden pineapple, pink lotus, brown dates, coconut. Row 3: a small potted date palm sapling, a sprouting coconut in a small pot, a brown sack of fertilizer with a green leaf mark, a small metal garden sprinkler. Chunky simple game item icons, front view, thick dark outline, soft cel shading, every item fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with empty space around it, no text, no letters, no numbers, no border, no frame

style_image.usage_description: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view, one object centered in each cell. Do not copy these objects, their colors or their layout.
